tagline: One calm place for your next application.
libraryIntro: Add the material you already have. Kiwi keeps the originals local, organises them and retrieves deeper detail when a task needs it.
libraryServiceUnavailable: Kiwi could not load your career library from the local Agent service.
libraryConnectIntro: Start and connect the local service before adding career material.
libraryResetHelp: Removes all career sources, indexes, analyses, application records and generated materials. Jobs, filters, settings and your API key are kept.
libraryResetConfirm: Reset this career workspace? All career sources, indexes, analyses, application records and generated materials will be permanently deleted. Jobs, filters, settings and your API key will be kept.
libraryResetComplete: Career workspace reset. You can add fresh career material.
libraryResetFailed: Kiwi could not reset the career workspace. No data was changed.
libraryImportIntro: Add a PDF, Word (.docx), Markdown or text file. Files are limited to 2 MB and 100,000 extracted characters; PDFs are also limited to 50 pages. The original is saved locally first; extracted text is then sent to your configured AI model for classification and useful suggestions.
libraryImporting: {file} selected — Kiwi is reading it now…
libraryImportingHelp: The original is saved locally first. Kiwi is identifying the source and indexing what it says; keep this panel open.
libraryImportUnsupported: Choose a PDF, Word (.docx), Markdown or plain-text file. Legacy .doc files are not supported.
libraryImportLimitExceeded: This document exceeds an import limit: 2 MB per file, 100,000 extracted characters or 50 PDF pages.
libraryImportNoText: Kiwi found no selectable text. A scanned PDF needs OCR before it can be imported.
libraryImportUnreadable: Kiwi could not read this file. It may be damaged or password-protected.
libraryImportTimeout: Understanding this source took too long. Try a shorter, text-based document.
libraryImportFailed: Kiwi could not understand this source. Please try again.
librarySourceSaved: Source saved and organised in your local career library.
librarySourceSavedNeedsAttention: Source saved locally. Kiwi could not understand it yet, so it has been marked for attention.
librarySourceDuplicate: This exact file is already in your career library.
librarySourcesIntro: Originals stay separate. Missing information in one CV is not treated as missing from your career history.
librarySourcesEmpty: No sources yet. Add a CV, visa, certificate or project document to start.
libraryConflictsIntro: These files make different exclusive claims. Choose the current value, or keep both when they apply in different contexts.
librarySourceNeedsReprocess: Its internal index is missing or outdated. The original file is still safe.
libraryConflictContextual: Both are valid in different contexts
libraryConflictResolved: Conflict resolved. The original files were not changed.
libraryConflictResolveFailed: Kiwi could not save this decision. The source files were not changed.
librarySourceReprocessed: Kiwi refreshed what it understands from this source.
librarySourceActionFailed: Kiwi could not complete that source action. Nothing was lost.
libraryDeleteSourceConfirm: Delete {file} and everything Kiwi extracted from it? Other sources are not changed.
rulesIntro: Choose what should disappear from your search results.
dismissedIntro: Review jobs you chose not to see again.
distanceIntro: Keep results within a practical distance from you.
settingsIntro: Manage how Kiwi works, connects and stores your data.
searchControlsIntro: Decide which SEEK results deserve your attention.
searchActivityEmpty: Open a SEEK search to see live filtering activity.
showHiddenSwitch: Show filtered jobs on the page
title: Title
invalidRule: Enter a valid pattern and select at least one field.
showDistanceHelp: Display Kiwi’s conservative distance estimate in SEEK results.
geolocationExplanation: Your location is requested only when you press the button. It is rounded and stored locally; continuous location tracking is never used.
geolocationFailed: Location access failed. Choose a known New Zealand place instead.
invalidDistance: Enter a distance greater than zero.
straightLineExplanation: Distances are straight-line estimates, not road travel distances. A job is hidden only when the conservative minimum distance exceeds your limit.
locationDataAttribution: Contains data sourced from the LINZ Data Service licensed for reuse under CC BY 4.0.
showSeenHelp: Mark jobs that you have already opened.
generalSettingsIntro: Choose language and what Kiwi adds to SEEK cards.
dataPrivacyIntro: Understand, export or import data stored by Kiwi.
exportSettingsHelp: Download your rules and preferences as JSON.
importSettingsHelp: Merge rules and preferences from a Kiwi JSON export.
privacy: Rules and job history stay on this device. Language and ordinary UI preferences may sync through your browser account.
agentServerIntro: Start the local service, then pair it with the same private token. The token stays in local browser storage.
agentTokenInvalid: Enter a token containing at least 32 characters.
agentUnavailable: The local Agent server is unavailable or rejected this extension.
agentIntro: Kiwi checks this SEEK role against the career details and experience you provide.
syncingCurrentJobHelp: Kiwi will update automatically when you change jobs or tabs.
agentNoJobTitle: Open a job to get started
agentAutoSync: No refresh needed — Kiwi follows your active SEEK tab.
agentSetupIntro: Add your private pairing token once, then return here to analyse this role.
agentNoSeekJob: Choose a SEEK job detail page and Kiwi will pick it up automatically.
agentExtractionFailed: The current job could not be read safely. Open a SEEK job detail page and try again.
agentExpandDescription: Expand the full job description on SEEK before analysing. Kiwi will resync it.
agentAnalysingStatus: The Agent is choosing tools and checking your experience. This may take a little while.
agentChoosingNextCheck: Completed the checks below. Kiwi is deciding what to inspect next.
agentNotConfigured: Configure the local Agent token in Settings first.
agentAnalysisFailed: Kiwi could not complete this analysis. Please try again.
agentLibraryEmpty: Add career material to your Library before analysing a job.
agentStepLimit: Kiwi could not safely finish this pass. Completed checks were saved — try again to continue from them.
agentTimeout: The model stopped responding. Completed checks were saved — try again to continue from them.
agentOutputInvalid: Kiwi could not assemble a valid result from the completed checks. Try again to continue from them.
agentModelError: The AI service interrupted this pass. Completed checks were saved — try again to continue; if it keeps happening, check that your model account is active.
agentInvalidJob: Kiwi could not use the current job information. Reopen the job page and try again.
agentClarificationInvalid: These questions are no longer current. Analyse the job again to continue.
agentServiceUnavailable: Kiwi lost connection to the local Agent. Keep its terminal running, then try again.
agentClarificationIntro: Answer these missing facts, then Kiwi will reconsider the same job.
agentClarificationPrivacy: Used for this job analysis only. Your Library is not changed.
agentNoTools: No tools were used in this run.
agentHistoryFound: A previous application record was found.
agentHistoryNotFound: No previous application record was found.
agentStatusFailed: The application status could not be saved.
agentMaterialsIntro: Generate a tailored CV and cover letter grounded in your source library. Your uploaded sources are not changed.
agentPreparingMaterialsHelp: Kiwi is selecting relevant source material, tailoring the CV variant, and drafting the cover letter. Keep the local Agent running.
agentOpenMaterialsHelp: Review the available CV and cover letter materials in a separate tab.
agentMaterialsFailed: Materials could not be generated from this analysis.
materialsPageIntro: Review and download the CV or cover letter Kiwi prepared for this application.
materialsInvalidLink: This material link is incomplete. Open it again from the Kiwi side panel.
materialsUnavailable: Kiwi could not load these materials. Check that the local Agent is running, then try again.
materialsCoverLetterHelp: You can edit this draft before downloading. Edits on this page are not saved yet.
includeOriginExport: Include my commute origin coordinates in this file
includeOriginImport: Import the commute origin coordinates from this file
fileTooLarge: Import files must be 10 MB or smaller.
clearDataConfirm: Delete the commute origin, local rules, diagnostics, and job history?
